description: This file defines the InPredicateImpl class, which represents an implementation of an 'in' predicate used in query criteria within the Ditto framework. It extends a base predicate class, accepts a list of values, and implements an accept method for visitor pattern traversal.

classes.name: InPredicateImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of an 'in' predicate for query criteria, holding a list of values and accepting visitors.
